# scip tools

Code intelligence - find definitions, references, dependencies, and call chains using SCIP indexes

11 tools. All categories: [MCP Tool Catalog](README.md).

## `scip_callchain`

[SCIP] Trace execution paths from entry point to target symbol.

- Permission: `query_repos`
- Source: [scip/scip_callchain.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/scip/scip_callchain.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `from_symbol` | string | yes | Starting symbol (e.g., 'handle_request', 'Controller.process') |
| `to_symbol` | string | yes | Target symbol to reach (e.g., 'DatabaseManager', 'authenticate') |
| `max_depth` | integer | no | Maximum chain length to search. |
| `repository_alias` | string or null | no | Repository alias to filter SCIP search. |

## `scip_references`

- Source: [scip/scip_references.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/scip/scip_references.md)
